entities.summary: Malcolm Xavier Griffin is an American professional basketball player. Standing at 1.93 m, he plays at the point guard and shooting guard positions. After two years at Toledo and two years at Fresno Pacific he played professional basketball in Morocco, Tunisia, Latvia, Greece, Russia and Israel.
